resources.string:
Enabling this allows Warden to:
1. Detect and block keywords across apps
2. Identify and hide distracting UI elements
3. Protect against forced uninstallation

Warden needs access to accessibility data to scan on-screen text for blocked keywords and identify UI elements you want to hide. This lets Warden help you stay focused and reduce distractions.

Rest assured, all accessibility data stays securely on your device—we never share or transmit your data, ensuring your privacy is always protected.
WARNING: Link blocker may not work everywhere.
Password is required to delete keywords
Password must be strong (at least 6 characters, including a letter and a number).
